title: Filtered homotopies agree on spectral sequences from the second page
statement: Let $C^\bullet$ and $D^\bullet$ be cochain complexes in an abelian category, each equipped with a decreasing filtration [def-sp-filtration] such that for every cochain degree $n$ there are integers $p_-$ and $p_+$ with $F^{p_-}C^n=C^n$, $F^{p_+}C^n=0$, and likewise for $D^n$. Let $a,b:C^\bullet\to D^\bullet$ be filtered chain maps, and suppose there are maps $h^n:C^n\to D^{n-1}$ with $a-b=d_Dh+hd_C$ and $h^n(F^pC^n)\subseteq F^{p-1}D^{n-1}$ for every $p$. Then the spectral-sequence maps induced by $a$ and $b$ are equal on every page $E_r$ for $r\ge2$, and their maps on the abutment filtrations and the associated graded pieces [def-sp-convergence] agree.
